subject.title: feat(session): add chat-channel session switching with LRU history retention

question: Which chat-session command contract should OpenClaw accept before either open `/sessions` or `/resume` candidate can merge?
rationale: This PR overlaps the open `/resume` candidate and changes visible chat commands, persisted session state, auth/provider continuity, and cleanup semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract or restore policy.

options.title: Choose the canonical contract first
options.body: Use the open tracker to decide `/sessions` versus `/resume`, then require the chosen branch to repair session-boundary and cleanup blockers before merge.

options.title: Sponsor this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate, but require full boundary repair, cleanup-reference coverage, branch refresh, and redacted real chat proof.

options.title: Wait for a replacement
options.body: Leave this PR blocked until a smaller proven replacement branch exists, then close this one only after the replacement is viable.

recommendation.title: Choose the canonical contract first
recommendation.body: Use the open tracker to decide `/sessions` versus `/resume`, then require the chosen branch to repair session-boundary and cleanup blockers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-management and session-state history makes this the best available owner signal for the command-contract and restore-boundary decision.
